svg.text: One mark, four products. Generated from docs/brand/src — this sheet cannot drift from the shipped assets.
whirl chip — the sum of the three
measured off the reference art, not invented
Highlighter — the two strokes over the notes
TroubaStack — neutral; its stroke runs all three layers
At MINIMAL there is no chip: one stroke in the mark's colour is what separates the four.
the real icons at 48 / 32 / 16 px, not drawings of them
